title: Northwind Studio: room booking, as the office manager and the domain experts keep it

changes: First release, from the office handbook, revision 1.
Focus rooms: a booking is now limited to 1 hour (was 2).

concepts.name: Request
concepts.definition: A request to book a meeting room for a number of hours.

concepts.name: Focus
concepts.definition: A small room for one or two people to concentrate in.

rules.text: Focus room: a booking of up to 2 hours is granted; a longer one is refused.
Focus room: a booking of up to 1 hour is granted; a longer one is refused.

concepts.name: Workshop
concepts.definition: A large room for a team session.

rules.text: Workshop room: a booking of up to 4 hours is granted; a longer one is refused.
